note.after_visit_summary: You have a bladder infection, also called acute cystitis. We found burning when you urinate, needing to go often, and mild lower belly pressure. Your urine test showed signs of infection. We are starting you on an antibiotic called nitrofurantoin: take 100 mg by mouth twice a day with food for 5 days. You may continue the AZO for urinary pain for one more day only, then stop it. Drink plenty of water. We sent a urine culture to confirm the infection; results will take 2-3 days. If the culture shows the antibiotic won’t work, we will call you to change it. Call us the same day if you get fever, back or side pain, or vomiting, as this could mean a kidney infection. Also call if you are not better in 2-3 days. Otherwise, no follow-up is needed. Use your cell phone at 555 -0118 to reach us. Feel better soon.
